consumer: mission::is_complete (MGOAL_FIND_ITEM) asks whether the player has the required quantity of the quest item; the HUD merely shows what this check already decides.
scope: items reachable via crafting_inventory() (own carried items PLUS nearby reachable items), not just the character's own carried items
decisive_source: src/mission.cpp::mission::is_complete — computes the yes/no by testing u.crafting_inventory().has_amount(type->item_id, item_count) (with a charges fallback), returning the engine's own completion verdict
divergence: The required item sits in an adjacent container or on the ground within crafting reach but is NOT carried: crafting_inventory() counts it so is_complete()=true, while a re-derivation from write_carried_items (own carried items only) yields false — exposing the wrong-reach answer
